QF.id: XVI Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_14

question.text: For commodity derivative transactions, trading members must:

answer.text: Issue contract notes for all transactions without delay, with electronic contract notes (ECN) only on client consent
Issue contract notes only when the client requests one
Issue contract notes only for profitable trades
Not issue contract notes for commodity derivatives

explanation.text: The Logic: Trading members are required to issue contract notes for all transactions without delay. Electronic contract notes (ECN) may be issued only where the client has consented to receive contract notes in electronic form. CTT may also be specified in the daily contract notes. The Trap: Contract notes are not optional, are not conditional on client request or profitability, and are mandatory for commodity derivative transactions. Note: Clients should preserve contract notes received from the trading member and reconcile them against their own records to spot discrepancies promptly.
